title: Health and nutrition
coverAlt: A health worker caring for a baby while the mother looks on
headline: Building healthier communities, one family at a time
intro: We believe that every individual deserves access to quality healthcare, nutritious food, clean water and a safe environment. Our Health and Nutrition programme is dedicated to improving the well-being of mothers, children and vulnerable families through community-based healthcare initiatives, nutrition education and hygiene promotion.
closing: Together, we are working towards a future where no mother is left without care, no child suffers from preventable malnutrition, and every family has the knowledge and resources to live a healthier life.

activities.title: Maternal and Child Healthcare
activities.text: Promoting access to essential healthcare services for pregnant women, mothers, newborns and young children. We support maternal health awareness, antenatal care referrals and child health education.

activities.title: Nutrition and Food Security
activities.text: Supporting families with nutrition education, child growth monitoring, healthy feeding practices and awareness of balanced diets to prevent malnutrition.

activities.title: Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH)
activities.text: Promoting clean water, proper sanitation, handwashing and good hygiene practices to prevent diseases and create healthier communities.

activities.title: Community Health Awareness
activities.text: Organising community outreach, health education campaigns and awareness sessions to empower families with practical knowledge about disease prevention and healthy living.

title: Education and skill development
coverAlt: Illustration of gears and the words skill development
headline: Learning that opens doors for every girl and young person
intro: We believe education is the strongest path out of poverty. Our Education and Skill Development programme helps girls, boys and young people stay in school, learn practical skills and prepare for work or business.
closing: Together, we are working towards a future where no girl is forced out of school and every young person has the skills to earn a living and build a better life.

activities.title: Keeping Girls in School
activities.text: Encouraging school enrolment and attendance through mentoring, support for families and community dialogue with parents and leaders.

activities.title: Vocational and Technical Skills
activities.text: Practical training in trades such as tailoring, hairdressing, catering and crafts, so young people can earn an income.

activities.title: Adult Literacy and Numeracy
activities.text: Classes that help women who missed school to read, write and manage numbers with confidence.

activities.title: Digital and Life Skills
activities.text: Basic computer skills, communication, money management and job-readiness training for young people.

title: Women, girls and youth empowerment
coverAlt: A group of young women walking together
headline: When women, girls and young people lead, communities move forward
intro: Our empowerment programme builds confidence, leadership and voice among women, girls and young people, so they can take part in the decisions that shape their lives.
closing: Together, we are working towards a future where every woman, girl and young person is heard, valued and free to lead.

activities.title: Leadership Training and Mentoring
activities.text: Training and one-to-one mentoring that prepares women and young people to lead in their families, groups and communities.

activities.title: Girls' Clubs and Safe Spaces
activities.text: Safe places where girls meet, learn, share and build friendships under the guidance of trained mentors.

activities.title: Youth Engagement and Volunteering
activities.text: Opportunities for young people to volunteer, organise community activities and speak up on issues that matter to them.

activities.title: Women's Groups and Networks
activities.text: Supporting women to form groups and networks that share knowledge, support one another and raise their voices together.

title: Protection, equality and safeguarding
headline: Every woman, girl and child has the right to be safe
intro: We work to prevent violence, abuse and discrimination, and to make sure that women, girls and children are protected, respected and treated equally in their homes, schools and communities.
closing: Together, we are working towards a future where no one lives in fear and every person can claim their rights.

activities.title: Preventing Gender-Based Violence
activities.text: Awareness campaigns and community conversations that challenge harmful practices and promote respect at home and in public.

activities.title: Support and Referral for Survivors
activities.text: Listening, guidance and referral to health, legal and counselling services for people who have experienced violence.

activities.title: Child Protection and Safeguarding
activities.text: Working with families, schools and leaders to keep children safe, and training staff and volunteers in safeguarding.

activities.title: Gender Equality and Rights Awareness
activities.text: Helping women, men, girls and boys understand their rights and work together for equal opportunities.

title: Livelihood and poverty reduction
coverAlt: Women gathered with their goats in a village
headline: Building steady incomes and stronger households
intro: Our Livelihood and Poverty Reduction programme helps women and young people to earn, save and grow through small businesses, savings groups and practical training, so that families can meet their needs with dignity.
closing: Together, we are working towards a future where every family has a reliable income, savings for emergencies and a real chance to thrive.

activities.title: Village Savings and Loan Groups
activities.text: Helping women form savings groups where members save together, borrow small loans and support one another.

activities.title: Small Business Support
activities.text: Business training, start-up guidance and mentoring for women and young people starting or growing a business.

activities.title: Agriculture and Livestock Support
activities.text: Training and support in farming and animal keeping to improve food supply and household income.

activities.title: Financial Literacy and Market Links
activities.text: Lessons on budgeting and saving, and links to markets and buyers so that producers can sell at fair prices.

title: Peace building and community resilience
coverAlt: A handshake in front of a world map
headline: Strong communities stand together through hard times
intro: We support women, young people and local leaders to resolve conflict peacefully, build trust between neighbours and prepare for shocks such as conflict, drought and disease outbreaks.
closing: Together, we are working towards a future where communities settle differences peacefully and recover quickly from crises.

activities.title: Community Dialogue and Mediation
activities.text: Bringing neighbours and leaders together to talk through disputes and find peaceful solutions.

activities.title: Women and Youth in Peace-building
activities.text: Training women and young people as peace champions who can prevent conflict and speak for their communities.

activities.title: Disaster and Emergency Preparedness
activities.text: Helping communities plan for emergencies, share early warnings and recover faster when crises happen.

activities.title: Social Cohesion Activities
activities.text: Sports, cultural events and joint community projects that build trust across groups.
